description: A client-side font mod for MC 1.8.9.

mods.name: Fontr
mods.description: A global TrueType/OpenType font override for Minecraft 1.8.9. Generates high-resolution font sheets from a TTF/OTF and serves them to every text renderer.

releases.notes:
Fontr 1.0.1 for Minecraft 1.8.9.

Changes

- Support EvergreenHUD 3.10.1 lyric layout, which moved the buildFrame locals and added a trimmed field to Placed
- Match lyric locals by name instead of slot so minor EvergreenHUD updates keep working
- Support both 5 argument and 6 argument Placed constructors in the lyric row mirror

Install

Place fontr-1.0.1+mc1.8.9.jar in the instance mods folder. Remove older Fontr jars.

License

GPL-3.0-only.

releases.notes:
Fontr 1.0.0 for Minecraft 1.8.9 (Ornithe/Fabric).

Highlights

- Global TTF/OTF font override delivered through an OSL resource pack
- 4096 or 8192 ASCII sheets, lazy 256x256 unicode pages, merged glyph widths
- Real bold and italic sheets when face files are available
- Arabic shaping and right-to-left order in vanilla text, OneConfig, PolyCompose HUD text, Compose and EvergreenHUD lyrics
- Argentum chat and nametag integration, with optional real styles
- OneConfig settings page under Visuals

Requirements

- Minecraft 1.8.9 with Ornithe and Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer
- Ornithe Standard Libraries
- Java 21 or newer
- OneConfig 1.9 or newer for the settings page

Install

Place the jar in the instance mods folder, put fonts under .minecraft/config/Fontr/, then choose the font in OneConfig under Visuals, Fontr.

Tested on Linux with a OneClient 1.8.9 Ornithe instance using ArabicPixelSmall.ttf and Cascadia Code. Other clients, operating systems, Minecraft versions and scripts are not tested. See the README for the full list of tested and untested behavior.

License

GPL-3.0-only. See LICENSE in the repository.
